help.about: An endless snowboard ride down low-poly mountains. Ride for distance, chase the goals, or just cruise in Zen.

manifest.summary: Our own game in the spirit of Alto's Adventure: one button to jump and hold to backflip, down an endless mountain of flat-shaded low-poly ranges, with a day and night cycle, weather, and colours that follow the Forge accent.

features.name: Ride
features.description: Tap to jump, hold to backflip; chained tricks build a combo and a speed boost. Grind bunting ropes, bounce off rocks, clear chasms, collect coins, catch runaway goats.

features.name: Goals
features.description: Twelve levels of three goals each (data/levels.json); a crash ends the run.

features.name: Zen
features.description: No score and no end: a fall puts you back on the snow.

features.name: Today
features.description: A daily mountain: the same slope all day and a new one tomorrow, with today's best distance, points and runs on the title screen (#daily). Ways to ride come from the static/js/modes.js registry.

features.name: Best flag
features.description: A flag stands where your best run ended and riding past it says so; switch in Settings.

features.name: World
features.description: Three parallax layers of low-poly mountains, sun, moon, stars, northern lights, and seven weathers (snow, blizzard, rain, fog, thunderstorm, sand gusts, clear).

features.name: Art
features.description: Every shape is a JSON file in the shared Forge store (~/ForgeGameData/shapes/driftpeaks-*.json), editable in the game's Art screen.

known_gaps: Canvas 2D only; no touch-specific layout beyond tap-to-jump.
